MASTER EQUIPMENT RENTAL AGREEMENT

THIS MASTER EQUIPMENT RENTAL AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is entered into effective as of April 15, 2024 (the "Effective Date"), by and between SUMMITLIFT EQUIPMENT RENTALS, INC., a California corporation ("Lessor"), and MERIDIAN MECHANICAL GROUP, INC., a Delaware corporation d/b/a Meridian Plumbing, Heating & Air, located at 2150 Harbor Point Drive, Suite 400, Sacramento, California 95833 ("Lessee").

RECITALS

WHEREAS, Lessor is in the business of renting and leasing equipment used in construction, industrial, and commercial operations; and

WHEREAS, Lessee is engaged in the business of plumbing, heating, and air conditioning services, and desires to rent certain equipment from Lessor from time to time on a project basis;

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

1. DEFINITIONS

As used in this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below:

(a) "Equipment" means all scissor lifts, boom lifts, mobile cranes, pipe-threading machines, and other equipment as may be specified in individual Rental Contracts, together with all attachments, components, and accessories thereto.

(b) "Rental Contract" means the individual written agreement, rental order form, or invoice issued by Lessor with respect to a particular Equipment rental, which shall specify the Equipment, rental term, rental rate, delivery location, and other terms specific to that rental.

(c) "Rental Period" means the period of time commencing on the date Equipment is delivered to and received by Lessee and ending upon the date Equipment is returned to Lessor's facility or other location designated by Lessor, whether or not Equipment is actually in use during such period.

(d) "Rental Charges" means the charges set forth in the applicable Rental Contract, including daily or weekly rental rates, delivery and pickup fees, damage waiver fees, and any other charges due from Lessee to Lessor hereunder.

(e) "Damage Waiver" means the optional protection plan pursuant to Section 5 of this Agreement.

(f) "Applicable Law" means all applicable Federal, state, local, and municipal laws, ordinances, rules, regulations, codes, and permits governing the use of Equipment in the State of California and elsewhere as applicable.

2. RENTAL CONTRACTS

2.1 Individual Rental Terms. Each rental of Equipment shall be governed by an individual Rental Contract executed by both parties. Each Rental Contract shall incorporate and be subject to the terms and conditions of this Master Agreement. In the event of any conflict between the terms of a specific Rental Contract and this Master Agreement, the terms of the specific Rental Contract shall control only with respect to Equipment-specific matters such as rental rates, rental period, and delivery location; provided that all other terms of this Master Agreement shall remain in full force and effect.

2.2 Equipment Description. Each Rental Contract shall identify the specific Equipment being rented, including model number, serial number, and capacity where applicable. Lessee shall be responsible for ensuring that the Equipment specified in each Rental Contract is suitable for Lessee's intended use.

2.3 Term. Each Rental Contract shall specify the initial Rental Period. Rental Periods may be extended by mutual written agreement, in which case daily rental rates shall continue to accrue on a pro-rata basis.

2.4 Cancellation. LESSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY RENTAL CHARGES AND PERFORM ITS OBLIGATIONS HEREUNDER ARE ABSOLUTE, IRREVOCABLE, AND UNCONDITIONAL UNDER ANY AND ALL CIRCUMSTANCES WHATSOEVER. LESSEE SHALL HAVE NO RIGHT TO CANCEL OR TERMINATE ANY RENTAL CONTRACT EXCEPT BY PRIOR WRITTEN CONSENT OF LESSOR, AND THEN ONLY UPON PAYMENT OF ALL ACCRUED RENTAL CHARGES AND A CANCELLATION FEE EQUAL TO THIRTY PERCENT (30%) OF THE TOTAL ESTIMATED RENTAL CHARGES FOR THE ORIGINAL RENTAL PERIOD.

3. RENTAL CHARGES

3.1 Rental Rates. Lessor's standard rental rates as of the Effective Date are as follows:

Scissor Lifts (19-foot, self-propelled): $185.00 per day; $650.00 per week
Boom Lifts (40-foot, articulating): $275.00 per day; $875.00 per week
Mobile Cranes (12-ton capacity): $325.00 per day; $975.00 per week
Pipe-Threading Machines (rental package): $95.00 per day; $425.00 per week

Rates are subject to change upon thirty (30) days' written notice to Lessee.

3.2 Delivery and Pickup Fees. Delivery and pickup fees shall be charged as set forth in the applicable Rental Contract, typically ranging from $150.00 to $500.00 per trip depending on delivery distance and Equipment type. Deliveries to locations within Sacramento County are included in the base rental rate for Rental Periods of seven (7) days or longer.

3.3 Payment Terms. Rental Charges shall be due and payable within fifteen (15) days of invoice date. Invoices shall be issued by Lessor upon delivery of Equipment or as specified in the Rental Contract. A late charge of one and one-half percent (1.5%) per month (18% per annum) shall accrue on all past-due amounts.

3.4 Fuel and Operating Costs. For all powered Equipment, Lessee shall be responsible for all fuel and operating costs incurred during the Rental Period. Lessee shall return Equipment with fuel tanks filled to the same level as delivery.

4. EQUIPMENT ACCEPTANCE AND CONDITION

4.1 Inspection Upon Delivery. Lessee shall inspect all Equipment upon delivery and shall execute a Certificate of Acceptance within twenty-four (24) hours of receipt. Any discrepancies, damage, or defects noted prior to acceptance shall be reported to Lessor in writing within forty-eight (48) hours of delivery. Lessee's execution and delivery of a Certificate of Acceptance shall be conclusive evidence that Equipment is in satisfactory condition and suitable for Lessee's intended use.

4.2 Condition Upon Return. Lessee shall return all Equipment in the same condition as received, ordinary wear and tear excepted. Equipment shall be thoroughly cleaned and free of all dirt, debris, and materials prior to return.

4.3 Missing or Broken Components. Lessee shall be liable for the cost of replacement or repair of any missing, broken, or damaged components of Equipment, whether or not covered by the Damage Waiver.

5. DAMAGE WAIVER

5.1 Optional Protection Plan. Lessor offers an optional Damage Waiver protecting Lessee against charges for accidental damage to Equipment during the Rental Period. The Damage Waiver does not cover normal wear and tear, maintenance items, fuel, or operator-caused negligence.

5.2 Damage Waiver Fee. The Damage Waiver fee shall be fifteen percent (15%) of the total Rental Charges for the applicable Rental Period. Lessee may elect to purchase the Damage Waiver on a per-rental basis by indicating acceptance on the Rental Contract.

5.3 Damage Waiver Exclusions. The Damage Waiver does not cover damage resulting from: (i) theft; (ii) unauthorized use; (iii) failure to properly maintain Equipment; (iv) use in violation of Applicable Law or manufacturer's specifications; (v) operator error or negligence; (vi) failure to return Equipment on time; or (vii) gross negligence or willful misconduct by Lessee or its employees.

5.4 Damage Assessment. In the event of damage to Equipment, Lessor reserves the right to assess repair costs and provide Lessee with a damage invoice. If Damage Waiver was not purchased, Lessee shall be responsible for one hundred percent (100%) of repair costs plus a damage assessment fee of $75.00.

6. INDEMNITY

6.1 Indemnification by Lessee. LESSEE SHALL INDEMNIFY, DEFEND, AND HOLD HARMLESS LESSOR AND ITS OFFICERS, DIRECTORS, EMPLOYEES, AND AGENTS FROM AND AGAINST ANY AND ALL CLAIMS, DAMAGES, INJURIES, LOSSES, LIABILITIES, AND EXPENSES (INCLUDING REASONABLE ATTORNEYS' FEES AND COSTS) ARISING OUT OF OR RESULTING FROM: (i) LESSEE'S USE, OPERATION, POSSESSION, OR CONTROL OF EQUIPMENT; (ii) LESSEE'S BREACH OF ANY TERM OR CONDITION OF THIS AGREEMENT OR ANY RENTAL CONTRACT; (iii) PERSONAL INJURY, DEATH, OR PROPERTY DAMAGE CAUSED BY EQUIPMENT OR LESSEE'S USE THEREOF; (iv) LESSEE'S FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH APPLICABLE LAW; OR (v) ANY OTHER ACT OR OMISSION BY LESSEE OR ITS EMPLOYEES, AGENTS, OR CONTRACTORS.

6.2 No Limitation on Indemnity. THE INDEMNITY OBLIGATIONS SET FORTH IN SECTION 6.1 SHALL NOT BE LIMITED BY ANY INSURANCE COVERAGE MAINTAINED BY LESSEE AND SHALL APPLY WHETHER OR NOT LESSOR IS NEGLIGENT.

6.3 Procedure. Lessor shall provide Lessee with prompt written notice of any claim subject to indemnification hereunder. Lessee shall assume the defense of any such claim through counsel acceptable to Lessor, and Lessor shall have the right to participate in the defense at Lessee's expense.

7. INSURANCE

7.1 Insurance Requirements. Throughout each Rental Period and for thirty (30) days thereafter, Lessee shall maintain, at its sole cost and expense, comprehensive general liability insurance with a minimum limit of Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000.00) per occurrence and Four Million Dollars ($4,000,000.00) in the aggregate, covering bodily injury, property damage, and personal injury arising out of Lessee's use of Equipment.

7.2 Additional Insured. Lessor shall be named as an additional insured on all liability policies required hereunder. Certificates of Insurance shall be provided to Lessor prior to the delivery of Equipment for each Rental Period.

7.3 Equipment Insurance. Lessee shall maintain property insurance on all Equipment during each Rental Period in an amount equal to the full replacement value of Equipment. Such insurance shall name Lessor as the loss payee. Alternatively, Lessee may pay the Damage Waiver fee in lieu of maintaining separate equipment insurance.

7.4 Workers' Compensation. Lessee shall maintain workers' compensation insurance in compliance with California law, with a minimum limit of One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) per occurrence.

7.5 No Waiver. Lessor's failure to require proof of insurance shall not waive Lessee's obligation to maintain insurance, nor shall it constitute a waiver of any rights of Lessor hereunder.

8. MAINTENANCE AND OPERATION

8.1 Maintenance. Lessee shall maintain Equipment in good working condition during each Rental Period, including all routine maintenance such as fluid checks, filter changes, and lubrication as required by the Equipment manufacturer.

8.2 Operators. Equipment shall be operated only by trained, qualified operators in compliance with all Applicable Law and manufacturer's specifications. Lessee shall ensure all operators have proper licensing and certifications as required by California law.

8.3 Prohibited Uses. Equipment shall not be used for purposes other than those specified in the Rental Contract. Equipment shall not be used in violation of Applicable Law, manufacturer's recommendations, or safety regulations.

8.4 Immediate Notice of Damage. Lessee shall provide Lessor with immediate written notice of any damage, malfunction, or accident involving Equipment during the Rental Period.

9. RETURN OF EQUIPMENT

9.1 Return Deadline. All Equipment must be returned to Lessor's facility located at 4521 Industrial Boulevard, Sacramento, California 95838, or other location designated by Lessor, no later than 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time on the last day of the Rental Period.

9.2 Late Return Charges. If Equipment is not returned by the return deadline, daily rental charges shall continue to accrue at one hundred fifty percent (150%) of the standard daily rate until Equipment is returned and received by Lessor.

9.3 Return Condition. Equipment shall be returned clean, refueled, and in the same condition as delivered, ordinary wear and tear excepted. Lessor shall not be responsible for any items left in Equipment.

10. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION

10.1 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California, without regard to its conflict of law principles. THE PARTIES EXPRESSLY EXCLUDE THE APPLICATION OF THE UNITED NATIONS CONVENTION ON CONTRACTS FOR THE INTERNATIONAL SALE OF GOODS.

10.2 Jurisdiction and Venue. Each party irrevocably consents to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of the state and federal courts located in Sacramento County, California for resolution of any disputes arising out of or related to this Agreement.

10.3 Attorneys' Fees. In any action to enforce this Agreement, the prevailing party shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys' fees and costs from the non-prevailing party.

11. GENERAL PROVISIONS

11.1 Entire Agreement. This Agreement, together with all Rental Contracts executed pursuant hereto, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties concerning the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, and agreements.

11.2 Amendments. No amendment to this Agreement shall be valid unless in writing and executed by authorized representatives of both parties.

11.3 Severability. If any provision of this Agreement is found to be invalid or unenforceable, such provision shall be reformed to the minimum extent necessary to make it enforceable, or if such reformation is not possible, shall be severed, and the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.

11.4 Notices. All notices required hereunder shall be in writing and delivered personally, by facsimile, by email with confirmation of receipt, or by certified mail, return receipt requested, to the addresses of the parties set forth herein.

11.5 No Waiver. The failure of either party to enforce any right or provision of this Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of such right or provision.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Master Equipment Rental Agreement as of the Effective Date.
